verdict.rationale: Xero exposes a general ledger API/SDK and an MCP server with chart-of-accounts and invoice/bill management (with draft-for-approval workflows shown for bills), suggesting an agent could programmatically interact with ledger data, but no evidence specifically documents journal-entry creation via API/MCP or a review-queue mechanism for an accountant to approve agent-drafted entries. Missing for 10: explicit journal entry API/MCP endpoint documentation, a documented draft/pending-approval state for journals, and any review-queue or approval workflow for accountants.
